plan.notes: Source: Agnes Scott College 2025-2026 Undergraduate Academic Catalog (official PDF), Biology major requirements: 40 cr minimum in biology (excl. 101/108/140/380); core BIO-110/110L, 111/111L, BIO-491; Chemistry 150/150L + two of (CHE-220 w/lab, 230, 240 w/lab, 300 w/lab); MAT-115 + (117/118/119); breadth groups I/II/III + four additional biology courses. Hand-transcribed 2026-09-30. Semester sequence assembled from catalog requirements + prerequisites (advisor should confirm). CHE-230 + CHE-240/240L chosen for the two-chemistry-course slot (CHE-220 has no listing; CHE-150 has no listing - see UNRESOLVED-1). Gen ed = SUMMIT 34 cr + 12 cr language (3 courses; actual placement may vary) + electives to 128. CHE-110 is a catalog-stated prerequisite of CHE-230/CHE-240; not a plan course (placement or prior credit), recorded in external_prereqs.
